residual_risks: The browser validates deviceTimezone against its own Intl timezone database while firmware validates against embedded TZDB 2025b; a future browser-only IANA zone could make an otherwise valid web configuration fail during device staging.
testing_gaps: No firmware integration test renders a forecast with device_timezone different from spot.timezone and asserts that updated_time uses the former while forecast dates and sample hours use the latter.

The web and firmware digest fixtures only share a constant for the same device and spot timezone; there is no cross-language fixture proving digest parity when deviceTimezone differs from spot.timezone.
Installer-service tests do not exercise rejection of a missing or unsupported deviceTimezone in an otherwise valid version-4 payload.
